# Ariral
## General Information
Ariral are a species from Voices of the Void with an unusual appearance that mixes features of other races. They have [color=lightgreen]natural night vision[/color] and [color=lightgreen]poisonous blood[/color].
Their digestive system can handle raw meat and blood without ill effects.
## Racial Traits
- [color=lightgreen]20% less Blunt damage[/color] and [color=lightgreen]20% less Slash damage[/color]. - [color=lightgreen]10% less Piercing damage[/color] and [color=lightgreen]20% less Poison damage[/color]. - [color=palevioletred]25% more Cold damage[/color] and [color=palevioletred]25% more Heat damage[/color]. - [color=palevioletred]Smaller blood supply[/color], and bleeding takes longer to stop. - [color=palevioletred]Tire out faster[/color] than other humanoids. - [color=palevioletred]Poorer cold resistance[/color]: being chilled slows them down.
